coach_verdict: Your freshness is optimal, but your fitness is dropping fast. Prioritize Priority 1 (VO2max Cycling) today to directly address your 5-minute power target while your leg fatigue is zero. Execute with high discipline and do not skip the structured intervals.

priority_1.reason: Highest recommendation. Your TSB is positive (+9.6) and acute fatigue is virtually zero, making today the optimal window to push VO2max capacity for cycling 5-minute power goals without injury risk.

priority_2.workout_details: 10 min Zone 2 jog warm-up + dynamic drills. Main set: 4 x 1000m at target 5km pace (~RPE 8.5) with 2 minutes walking recovery. 10 min Zone 2 cool-down jogging.
priority_2.reason: Second priority. Targets your 5km running pace goal directly. Since running imposes higher orthopedic stress than cycling, this is ranked second given the recent 4-day layoff.
